steps.message: Create a timer with 17 hours, 51 minutes, and 18 seconds. Do not start the timer.
Execute: adb shell "pm list packages | grep -Ei 'clock|deskclock|alarm'"

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell "pm list packages | grep -Ei 'clock|deskclock|alarm'""

steps.message: Execute: adb shell "run-as com.google.android.deskclock sh -c 'pwd; ls -la; ls -la databases 2>/dev/null; ls -la shared_prefs 2>/dev/null; for f in shared_prefs/*.xml; do echo ==== $f ====; sed -n \"1,200p\" \"$f\"; done 2>/dev/null'"
